name: quarterdeck
description: Quarterdeck: standing goals for Claude Code that run on a schedule, ask before they act, and remember what you decided

plugins.name: quarterdeck-goals
plugins.description: Standing goals for Claude Code, like "keep my inbox under control" or "find the best new job ads each week". Each goal runs on a schedule in a background subagent, asks before it acts, and remembers what you decided. You approve or reject from the Goals pane beside the chat.

plugins.name: quarterdeck-guard
plugins.description: Holds each Quarterdeck goal run to what you have allowed: it refuses the kinds of action you turned off, makes the rest wait for your approval, and keeps run reports out of your chat. Required by quarterdeck-goals.
